Cooperative Planning. In cooperative planning, the leader is both developing the level of understanding necessary for the successful execution of their plan and goals, and building a unity and synergy between leader, colleagues and team members that is vital to achieve our goal of delegation of authority. When conducting cooperative planning, the discussion pre-decision needs to be distinct from and matched by wholehearted commitment post-decision. Whatever style of planning is used, the leader should not lose sight of their responsibility for the decision and the team. There will, of course, be times when time pressure or other factors guide a leader to choose a more directive style.
